wholePhysicalScope: The named 12-corner Officers’ Quarters footprint on OpenStreetMap way 219731998 anchors the connected exterior and two open rear courts. The rectangular brick-pier entrance projects toward Avenida del Libertador. The designation and the model cover the Officers’ Quarters building.
lodDetails: Four detail levels keep the hipped clay roofs, connected wings, two open rear courts and brick-pier porch. Closer views refine roof ridges, shutters and window frames.
limitations: The modern mapped main-building envelope is used for the July 2013 exterior. The entrance porch projection, roof sections, wing heights, bay spacing and southeast assignment of the low rear arm are visual estimates.
The two 2013 photographs establish the material palette and the distinction between the low arm and the three-storey wings. Main avenue elevation details are reconstructed from the written record.
The original 128-meter elevation field remains unchanged. Ground contact, the approach steps and the exposure of the textured base are estimates at the original provider resolution.
The model depicts the exterior before the 2014–2015 exhibit works. Its date range applies to the represented 2013 state.
